description: OBSERVE mode (Cosmos C1). 5 campaigns, 14 ad groups, 190 clicks, 1 conv. Brand exact only converter (48 clicks, 1 conv). Competitor claude_code $159 0 conv. No experiments yet.

Conversions flat while spend grew 21%. Deployed 7 new negatives (arena ai, google i studio, abacus ai, rocketcode2, claude code web, claude ai pricing, open router ai) x3 campaigns = 21 new. Previous negatives reducing waste ($79 new vs $282 last cycle).

Conversions flat at 21.5 for 3rd straight cycle while spend grew 19%. Deployed 8 new negatives (grok build, zzz code ai, codegraph github, ai detector for code, uizard io, hermes agent, qwen cli, coding plan) x3 campaigns = 24 new. Total negatives now 179. Cost/conv deteriorating rapidly - need campaign-level intervention.

ACT mode (Cosmos C8). 5577 clicks, 21.5 conv, $7417 spend (30d window). 6 ad groups eligible. CR dropped to 0.39% (from 0.45%), cost/conv new worst at $345 (from $305). Conversions FLAT at 21.5 for 4TH STRAIGHT CYCLE while spend grew 63% since C5. Deployed 5 new negatives (ai detector code, code review graph, code review benchmark, code agent ranking, codex code review bitbucket) x3 campaigns = 15 new. Total negatives now 194. Negative keyword marginal returns diminishing - new waste only $120. CRITICAL: Codereview $1778/0 conv (8 cycles, 24% of spend). Competitor/claude_code $1872/0 conv (1345 clicks). Blitzy growing (12 clicks from 2). New devin ad group (9 clicks, $14, 0 conv). Campaign-level intervention urgently needed - negative keywords alone cannot fix structural spend problems.

FIRST CONVERSION INCREASE IN 5 CYCLES: 21.5->25.5 (+19%), driven by brand (15->18) and generic (4.5->5.5). Deployed 5 new negatives (lovable dev, claude opus 4.8, codex vs claude code, code reviewer agent, com openai chat codex open) x3 campaigns = 15 new. Total negatives now 209.
